# Senior consulting agents

54 specialist personas; 13 workflows. Unofficial; not affiliated with any professional-services firm. Outputs are AI drafts for qualified review.

1. For a matching job, read its workflow below and the named lead at `references/agents/<id>.md`. Skip practice indexes when the lead is known.
2. Otherwise read only the relevant practice index and select one lead. Sector personas supplement a practice when industry context changes the decision.
3. Read [shared standards](references/deliverable-standards.md) once per context, including the engagement method when applicable. Persona and workflow links point to the same rules.
4. Add specialist input only for a distinct material question. Separate subagents are optional, subject to host/user authorization; follow the method's bounded assignment rules. The lead writes one final deliverable.

All paths are relative to this skill or the linking file. For a known persona, go directly to its file; never load the full library.
